title: feat(spec,objectql)!: report a caller value a stored expression replaced, as DroppedFieldsEvent reason stored_expression
body:
Closes #24690
Clause-②: no

## What

PR #24673 (`c0803b04d2`) made the engine compute a stored (non-`formula`) field's declared `expression` on every write, so a value the caller sends for such a field never stands. Before this PR nothing said so. `onFieldsDropped` stayed silent, so the PATCH and `/batch` doors answered with no `droppedFields`, and a flow's `update_record` reported success over a row that holds the computed value.

- **spec** (`packages/spec/src/data/data-engine.zod.ts`): `DroppedFieldsEventSchema.reason` gains `stored_expression`, with its describe. The field IS written, with the computed value in place of the caller's, so `computed` (a `formula` with no column, key dropped) would be untrue of it. The name follows the existing arms, which name the field's role (`primary_key`, `computed`) rather than what happened to the value. The `fields` describe and the schema describe now cover "written with the computed value" too. `contracts/data-engine.ts` (the `strictReadonlyWrites` TSDoc) names the fifth arm.
- **objectql** (`engine.ts`): `replacedStoredExpressionFields` reports a field when the caller sent it, no other strip took it, and the value stored differs from the caller's. It runs on insert (single, batch, and `insertMany`'s per-row `droppedFields`), update by id, and predicate update, in every context, `isSystem` included. A client that sends the computed value (the console grid's consistent save) or no value is told nothing. A value a static `readonly` strip already took is reported once, as `readonly`. On insert the compute pass moved ahead of the report block, and on update the compute pass moved ahead of `assertNoStrictDrops()`. Nothing else ran between the old and new positions.
- **strictReadonlyWrites**: its contract says its coverage is derived from the set `onFieldsDropped` reports. So a strict write whose value differs from the computed one is now refused with `ERR_READONLY_FIELD_REJECTED`, and nothing is written. `readonly-strict-errors.ts` words the new reason and its remedy. This is the accept-set narrowing the changeset declares BREAKING (shipped as `minor`). No non-test producer of `strictReadonlyWrites` exists in this repo (`git grep` outside `packages/objectql` and `packages/spec`: zero hits).
- **service-automation** (`crud-nodes.ts`): `DROPPED_REASON_LABEL` is an exhaustive `Record` over the reason union, so it needs the new row to typecheck. The step warning for this reason says the requested value(s) were NOT stored and that the write succeeded with the computed value(s). The other reasons keep their exact text.
- **Generated**: `content/docs/references/**` regenerated with `check:generated --fix` (only `check:docs` was stale).

## Tests (on `7b1b1fd8bc`)

- New `packages/objectql/src/engine-stored-expression-dropped-fields.test.ts`: by-id update (the PATCH door and each by-id `/batch` op), insert single, batch and `insertMany`, predicate update, controls for an equal value and an unsent value, the single report when the `readonly` strip took the value, and the `strictReadonlyWrites` refusal on all three paths. `engine-stored-expression-write.test.ts` now also expects the `stored_expression` event in its card scenario.
- New `packages/rest/src/rest-stored-expression-dropped-fields.test.ts`: through the composed stack (`RestServer`, then the protocol, then `ObjectQL`, then a real `SqlDriver` on better-sqlite3). PATCH answers `droppedFields` and the `X-ObjectStack-Dropped-Fields` header. `/batch` tags the op index. Each has a consistent-value control.
- `crud-dropped-fields.test.ts` (service-automation) pins the new warning. `data-engine.test.ts` (spec) pins the five-value enum.
- Ablation, a one-time check with no test file left behind: `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` turned the reporter's guard into `return []` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `432596c51076` to `5554095ef6a0`). The two objectql files then failed 12 of 30 tests. The tool restored the file (blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty) and the tests were green again.
- Reverse check on the type: with the `stored_expression` row commented out of `DROPPED_REASON_LABEL`, `tsc --noEmit` in service-automation failed with TS2741 (`Property 'stored_expression' is missing`). Restored by the tool to the HEAD blob. So the typecheck read the rebuilt spec `.d.ts`.
- Suites: objectql full 452 files / 8507 tests passed. service-automation full 196 / 2603 passed. spec `data-engine.test.ts` 101 passed. rest new file 3 passed. Typecheck passed for spec, objectql, service-automation and rest. NOT MEASURED: the rest full suite, which hit the 10-minute foreground cap when chained after service-automation (this diff only adds one rest test file).
- Gates: `dispatch-gates --ran` reconciles 119 derived, 117 run, 2 NOT MEASURED. The two are `check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, which exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: unbuilt `client-react` and other dists). All others exited 0. One of them is `check:query-options-erasure`, re-run after it caught a cast in the new rest test and the cast was replaced by typed options.

## Acceptance notes

- **Landing hazard (objectui).** objectui's `STRIPPED_LINE` in `packages/app-shell/src/providers/writeWarningToast.ts` is a `Record` keyed by `DroppedFieldsEvent['reason']`. It is exhaustive on purpose, and it has four rows at the pinned `.objectui-sha` `12dc7b47c3`. `app-shell` builds with `tsc`, and `scripts/build-console.sh` installs this tree's `@objectstack/*` into the pinned objectui. So after this merges, the full-battery `Console Pin Gate` is expected to go red with a missing `stored_expression` key. The `computed` precedent (objectui#11206) widened the key type ahead of the pin. The same order applies here: an objectui PR adds a `stored_expression` row, keyed `| 'stored_expression'` until the pin carries it, then the pin bump. This was reasoned from the type and the build script, NOT MEASURED by running `build-console.sh`. The runtime skew path in objectui (`UNRECOGNIZED_DROP_REASON`) already keeps an unknown reason readable, so only the build is at stake.
- `Object.is` is the comparison, the same one the compute passes use, and the caller's values are normalized before the snapshot. A stored expression whose computed value has a different JS type than an equal value the caller sends (for example a date expression computing a `Date` against an ISO string) would be reported, and refused under strict. This edge was not measured.
- `ImportRowResult.droppedFields` (`api/export`), the `/batch` and protocol `droppedFields` describes still say "caller-supplied fields the engine LEGALLY strips". They now carry the fifth reason through the shared enum, but their prose does not mention "written with the computed value". Those schemas are outside this card's file surface.
- Open PR #24667 also edits `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`, in disjoint hunks (around lines 7110 to 7390, where this PR edits around 2300, 3020 to 3070, 16400, 17090 and 18080).
